lines.text: Cleaning stale branches, updating dependencies, trimming logs. Important, boring, and always skipped.
Every week you promise yourself you will get to it, and every week the pile gets bigger.
This is exactly the kind of work an agent is good at, as long as someone starts it.
So schedule it to run every Sunday night, on a cron.
Agent R Q creates the task by itself, and starts the agent at ten o clock.
The agent prunes the old branches, bumps the dependencies, and trims the logs.
But a risky step stops and waits for your approval first.
You see the exact command, and you allow it or deny it from your phone.
By Monday morning, the cleanup is finished and the repository is tidy.
And next Sunday, it simply happens all over again.
The boring work gets done, and you stay in charge of everything risky.
What chore would you give an agent forever? Tell us in the comments, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
